headers:
Unauthorized
Additional Work,
Variations in
Quantity and
Price Adjustment

No payment shall be issued for additional work, equipment, materials supplies or services beyond the contract
requirements. All variations in quantity provided, changes in pricing and additional work must be pre-
authorized in writing by the contracting officer or his/her designated representative, with a written
amendment or change order. Price adjustments may be audited where required.
sample:
Either party may request changes in the quantity of goods or services supplied or the performance criteria
described herein; however, adjustments to any subsequent contract or agreement shall not be valid or binding
upon either party unless such change or addition is in writing and signed by both parties. Such amendments
shall be attached to and made a part of any subsequent contract or agreement.
The Contractor shall be liable for all costs resulting from and/or for satisfactorily correcting any specification
change not properly ordered by written modification to the contract and signed by the Buyer's designated
representative. The Contracting Officer may at any time, by a written order and without notice to the sureties,
make changes within the general scope of any subsequent agreement on any of the following:
(i) specifications,
(ii) date of delivery; and
(iii) place of equipment delivery.
If any such change causes an increase or decrease in the cost of, or the time required for, the performance of
any part of the work under this Agreement, whether changed or not changed by any such order, an equitable
adjustment shall be made in the contract price or delivery schedule, or both, and the Agreement shall be
modified in writing accordingly. Any claim for an adjustment under this clause must be asserted within thirty
(30) calendar days from the date of receipt by the other party of the notification of change; provided, however,
that the Contracting Officer, if he/she decides that the facts justify such action, may receive and act upon any
such claim asserted at any time prior to final payment under this Agreement. Failure to agree to any
adjustment shall be a dispute concerning a question of fact within the meaning of the "Disputes" clause of the
Agreement. However, nothing in this clause shall excuse the Contractor from proceeding with an executed
Agreement, as changed.

The work to be performed under any subsequent agreement or contract shall commence after the issuance of
the written "Notice to Proceed" or other purchase directive document from the Buyer, and, when the
Contractor production scheduling is completed and accepted, to ensure the timely delivery of the purchased
materials or services within the terms of any Contract or Agreement. The duration of any subsequent contract
or agreement for the provision of materials or services under an IFB, RFP, Qualifications or Quote solicitation
shall be in accordance with the solicitation requirements or the agreed upon dates noted in a contract award,
effective from the issuance of the Notice to Proceed or contract execution to the completion of any acquisition
or Project. The provision of materials, work, and services under any subsequent contract or agreement are
directly related to and shall be coordinated, for the delivery of work and materials on schedule, as mutually
agreed by the Buyer and the Contractor.
An amendment to any subsequent contract or agreement, issued by the Buyer, is required to extend the time
for performing any work beyond the contracted completion date.

If the performance of the agreed upon work should be unavoidably delayed, the Contracting Officer shall
extend the time for completion of the contract for the determined number of days of excusable delay. A delay
is unavoidable only if the delay was not reasonably expected to occur in connection with or during the
Contractor's performance, and was not caused directly or substantially by acts, omissions, negligence, or
mistakes of the Contractor, the Contractor's suppliers, or their agents, and was substantial and in fact caused
the Contractor to miss performance or work completion dates and could not adequately have been guarded
against by contractual or legal methods. Subject to authorized adjustments, completion and delivery of
material and services shall be achieved within the delivery or service schedule time periods specified in any
subsequent contract or agreement. The Buyer shall not be responsible for delays caused by weather, soil
conditions, underground obstructions, labor disputes, fire, flood, third parties, particularly public and private
utilities, or otherwise reasonably foreseeable delays.
The established completion time shall not be extended because of any delays attributable to the Contractor,
but may be extended by the Buyer in the event of a delay attributable to the Buyer, or because of unavoidable
delays caused by an act of God or governmental actions or other conditions beyond the control of the
Contractor, including, but not limited to, labor disputes, and/or properly notified and agreed upon delays in
the receipt of supplier materials.
